outputs.exact_statement: Each raw entry $F_j(r)$ lies in $\mathbb Q+\mathbb QG$. Consequently, if $G\in\mathbb Q$, then $\Delta_N\in\mathbb Q$ for every positive integer $N$.

With $\delta=(q+g+h)/n=5/24$, one has, for every positive integer $N$, $$\label{eq:two-adic-bound}
v_2(\Delta_N)\ge
-\left(\frac{\delta}{2}+\frac{\delta^2}{8}\right)n^2
-O_G\bigl(n\log(n+2)\bigr)
=-\frac{505}{4608}n^2-O_G\bigl(n\log(n+2)\bigr).$$ The same bound holds for every full minor of the raw column matrix.

Assume that $G\in\mathbb Q$. For every sufficiently large prime $p$, the determinant with scale parameter $N=p$ satisfies $$\label{eq:nonvanishing-exact-valuation}
 v_p(\Delta_p)=-96p.$$ In particular, $\Delta_p\ne0$ for every sufficiently large prime $p$.

Let $x_1,\ldots,x_n$ be distinct nonzero real numbers in $(-1,1)$ satisfying Equation [eq:case-condition]. There is a function $h_*$ holomorphic on a neighborhood of the closed unit disk such that $$h_*(x_i)=c_i x_i^{D_*},\qquad c_i=\begin{cases}1,&x_i<0,\\-5,&x_i>0,\end{cases} \qquad \sup_{|z|\le1}|h_*(z)|\le K_0 n, \quad K_0=10e^{12}.$$ The neighborhood may depend on the node list; the displayed bound does not.
